desc: The 24-in. 300 Series smart dishwasher from Bosch comes with 16 place settings with 5 wash programs and 3 cycle options to choose from. The Energy Star certified dishwasher features an EasyGlide rack system, PureDry, PrecisionWash, and AquaStop Plus.
hl: We take much care of the quality of our dishwashers.
